info.title: ConfidenceGuard local API
info.description: Loopback, session-owned transport. No hosted/multi-user service. Response additions are compatible; request fields are strict. Summary and coverage sections return objects; measurements and findings return paginated lists.

denominator_kind.description: Record support for the referenced eligibility population. Formula denominators and model-conditional paired supports are explicit in data.

metric_key.description: Historical semantic identity, distinct across targets/nominal levels/definitions. Shareable aliases disclose no private definition.

lineage.description: Frozen normalized-input or paired-relation lineage; protected local audience only.

denominator_kind.description: Record support for the referenced eligibility population. Formula denominators and model-conditional paired supports are explicit in data.

FittedMethod.description: Data-only. Field-specific finite-parameter and exact conformal-rank checks are mandatory at load.

output_path.description: Host-controlled; direct paths are not accepted.

drift_thresholds.description: Declared field-specific descriptive effect thresholds; none are supplied by default. No p-value or degradation conclusion.

model_digest.description: Supplied producer declaration, not publisher authentication. For pinned encoders, binds the verified model.safetensors SHA-256.

MembershipArtifact.description: Data-only, content-bound CG4 evidence. Strict shape, dimensions, dependencies and digests are validated by the application service.

FrozenHypothesisSet.description: Data-only, content-bound CG4 evidence. Strict shape, dimensions, dependencies and digests are validated by the application service.

InvestigationResult.description: Data-only, content-bound CG4 evidence. Strict shape, dimensions, dependencies and digests are validated by the application service.

ConfirmationAssessment.description: Data-only, content-bound CG4 evidence. Strict shape, dimensions, dependencies and digests are validated by the application service.

ConfirmationFeasibility.description: Data-only, content-bound CG4 evidence. Strict shape, dimensions, dependencies and digests are validated by the application service.

model_digest.description: Supplied producer declaration, not publisher authentication. For pinned encoders, binds the verified model.safetensors SHA-256.

config.description: CG4 defaults result_bytes to 268435456; other EvaluationConfig defaults apply. Explicit caller budgets are retained.

practical_thresholds.description: Explicit per-selected-candidate thresholds in authoritative metric units, frozen before H. No universal default.
